name: integrations

frames.best_why: Five rows of tiles are lit at full brightness with their coloured glows and icons clear.

tagline: Rows of glowing app-icon tiles drift sideways at different speeds.
summary: Several rows of dark rounded tiles, each holding a thin line icon over a soft patch of coloured light, slide across a black background at different speeds and directions. The tiles fade up one by one and the stack darkens toward its edges.
appearance: A stack of horizontal rows filled with near-black rounded-square tiles. Inside each tile sits a thin outline icon such as a globe, heart, rss or shield, above a blurred blob of orange, pink, blue, green or yellow light, and the bottom rows fade into black.
behaviour: Every row glides sideways on a loop, some in the opposite direction, so icons pass each other at differing rates. Tiles start black and fade in at random delays when the section scrolls into view, while a gradient dims the lower edge.
demo_content: Six generic icons: heart-handshake, globe, file, shield, rss and bar chart.
search_phrases: trusted by logos in a loop
partner tools on a landing page
use_when: A landing page wants a moving wall of partner or integration icons behind or beside a heading.
avoid_when: The rows run forever and the tiles carry no names, so visitors cannot tell which app each icon is.
customise: Nothing is exposed: the six icons and their glow colours are written into the component, so changing brands means editing the tiles array.
weight_why: Six tiles repeated five times per row across several rows, with marquee animation always running.

a11y.note: The icons have no text alternative and the endless marquee ignores reduced-motion, so it cannot be stopped.

issues: Icons have no labels, so the tiles read as generic shapes rather than recognisable brands.
The same six icons repeat across every row, making the wall look repetitive.
polish_why: Pleasant glow and varied speeds, but repeated unlabelled generic icons keep it ordinary.
